name: The Returning Feather

visual_review.method: Local visual inspection of final PNG and JPEG
visual_review.Pepe: Inherited wide mouth and heavy-lidded eyes retained
visual_review.hand_digits: Five on each of the two inherited hands, counted; no new hands or stencils
visual_review.palette: Charcoal and red ochre; exposed warm stone
visual_review.limitations: Local visual review, not independent human certification; stone inside the feathered patch is generatively reconstructed.

image_tool: built-in image_gen.imagegen; additive edit followed by bounded assembly
prompt: Preserve the inherited cave wall, every ancestral mark, framing, cracks and lighting. Add a small worn charcoal and red ochre feather beside two irregular pebbles on bare lower-center rock below the basket. No new hands or figures; preserve Pepe and five digits per hand. No text, numbers, captions, logos, borders or watermarks.

checks.public_capture_demo: 3 nodes and 23132 bytes audited; same-size one-byte damage rejected
